api.provider_note: all five model families called via the same SiliconFlow interface; family generalization only, NO provider generalization claimable
api.key_handling: read from environment/.env into memory only; NEVER printed, logged, or written to any file/manifest/report

model_substitution_forbidden: if any exact ID is unavailable at run time: STOP and report; never substitute a similar model

thinking_or_reasoning_switches.policy: query SiliconFlow docs per model before smoke; if a public OpenAI-compatible field is documented for a model, freeze the actual value in an addendum BEFORE smoke; otherwise use provider default and record it; per-model tuning to improve scores forbidden
thinking_or_reasoning_switches.deepseek_baseline_note: the frozen DeepSeek run used top-level enable_thinking=false on this gateway (documented in harness/llm.py); equivalent switches for new models are NOT assumed portable and follow the policy above

generation_params.same_params_within_model: KF and SA use byte-identical model-level params on the same model

task_set_and_order.pairing_rule: per-task KF/SA order fixed by schedule (150 KF-first / 150 SA-first); identical pairing reused for every model block

execution_policy.retry_policy: API technical failures only: retries=2 exponential backoff (harness built-in); logical failures NEVER retried; exhausted retries recorded technical_failure=true and kept
execution_policy.throttle_429_5xx_timeout: same exponential backoff path; if a task still fails technically it is kept as-is; no selective rerun of failed tasks beyond the ledger-resume rule
execution_policy.resume_policy: --resume skips completed (task_id, method) pairs already present with consistent hashes in the run ledger; successful records are never resampled
execution_policy.start_condition: MULTIMODEL_SMOKE_APPROVED then smoke pass, then MULTIMODEL_RUN_APPROVED MAX_TOTAL_CNY=<limit>
execution_policy.end_condition: each model block closed by: freeze raw writes -> SHA-256 -> seal -> manifest -> offline scoring; research ends when all four blocks sealed
execution_policy.no_performance_based_stopping: during a run only completion/error/cost/technical counters may be inspected; CVSR or any performance metric MUST NOT be viewed until seal; no early stop or selective rerun based on performance
execution_policy.incomplete_rule: if funds run short, pause only at a model-block boundary and mark the whole study INCOMPLETE; never choose the stopping point by observed performance

generalization_verdict_preregistered.MODEL_GENERALIZATION_PASS: all four new models have KF-SA CVSR delta > 0 AND >= 3 models' 95% CI lower bound > 0 (10k task-level paired bootstrap)
generalization_verdict_preregistered.MODEL_GENERALIZATION_PARTIAL: >= 3 new models delta > 0 but PASS criteria not met
generalization_verdict_preregistered.side_results_note: Fatal rate, Binding-F1 and cost reported independently; must NOT replace the primary verdict post hoc
generalization_verdict_preregistered.aggregation_rule: cross-model aggregation must NOT treat the reused 300 tasks as 1500 independent samples; use cluster bootstrap clustered by task_id keeping all model results, or label explicitly exploratory
generalization_verdict_preregistered.scope_limit: conclusions limited to cross-MODEL-FAMILY robustness; all calls via one SiliconFlow interface -> provider generalization NOT demonstrated; no SOTA / leaderboard / private-held-out claims

smoke_test_plan.budget: 16 method-runs max = 4 models x 2 DEV tasks x 2 methods
smoke_test_plan.dev_tasks: two clearly DEV-marked fixtures OUTSIDE External300 covering structured output + repair path
smoke_test_plan.results_use: never enters paper main results; never used to tune formal prompts
smoke_test_plan.compat_fixes: model-agnostic harness fixes only; each fix requires a test + disclosure; exact-ID substitution forbidden
